platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for issue #131 scrollback-content restore on top of the issue #133 named-layouts roll after auditing every session parser hunk. The session schema remains v1 and adds optional bounded plain-text pane scrollback snapshots; the parser keeps the reviewed .allocate = .alloc_always ownership fix, decodes layout placement as opaque JSON before constructing the strict placement-free shape, and drops over-limit snapshots without losing layout. Hashes reflect checkout normalization. The durable git_commit identifies the PR base; Contracts.99-Baselines.ps1 independently pins the reviewed session-schema digest so squash-merging and deleting the PR branch cannot disable fail-closed artifact verification.
